title: Check the phones out at shift start
purpose: Every phone goes out charged, empty of yesterday's footage, logged, and on the right head.
with: the Portfolio Manager, who checks the count
when: 7:00 AM, at clock-in, every shift. Recording starts at 8:00 AM.
takes: About an hour for ten phones.

steps.do: Count every phone against the sheet.
steps.detail: At a hub site, sign for the phones on the phone list first. By device number, spares included. Write the number and time.

steps.do: Check battery and upload on every phone.
steps.detail: Spares too. Not charged, still pending, or a storage warning means it stays on charge.
steps.check: Each held-back phone has a reason written.

steps.do: Confirm each wearer is on their own account.
steps.detail: Read the name in the collection app. Never shared, never someone else's.

steps.do: Log each phone, then hand it over.
steps.detail: Write name, device number, site, date. A spare goes under the spare's number.

steps.do: Fit the rig and check the angle.
steps.detail: Cap on, mount tight, camera on the hands. See the fit procedure.

steps.do: Tell the Portfolio Manager, then start.
steps.detail: Before 8:00 AM: the count, each phone held back, any wearer missing.

done: Every phone out is charged, with room for a full day, on its wearer's own account, and logged.

fails.then: Tell the Portfolio Manager before 8:00 AM. A second day of footage is an incident.
Count again. Call the Portfolio Manager now. Lost mode within the hour. Nobody wipes it first.

fails.if: A wearer is on the wrong account
fails.then: They do not film. Tell the Portfolio Manager now.

fails.if: A phone is low, cracked, or broken
fails.then: A spare goes out. Tell the Portfolio Manager the same shift. The Planning and Logistics Lead replaces what broke.
Call the Portfolio Manager now, check out what is here, and start on time.

escalate: Your Portfolio Manager now. No reply in 20 minutes, call Moharam.
